prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Charlotte NC?
answer_verbatim:
I can help — but “best” depends on what you want. Do you want a spray (airbrush) tan or UV tanning beds? Also tell me what part of Charlotte you’re in or a ZIP code (South End, Ballantyne, University area, etc.) and any budget or service preferences.

While you decide, here are quick tips to pick the best salon:
- Choose spray if you want a safer, UV-free tan; choose UV beds only if you understand the skin-cancer risks and want a longer-lasting deep tan.
- For spray tans: look for salons that use reputable solutions (Norvell, VersaSpa, Mystic), certified technicians, offer a patch test/consultation, show before/after photos, and provide aftercare instructions.
- For UV tanning: confirm the salon maintains and sanitizes beds, staff assess your skin type and recommend a schedule, they use modern beds (high-pressure or low-pressure depending on desired result), and you get protective eyewear.
- Read recent Google/Yelp reviews and check salons’ Instagram for client photos. Pay attention to comments about cleanliness, technician skill, and consistency.
- Ask about guarantees/refunds, pricing and packages, and when you should shower after a spray tan or how many sessions between UV appointments.

If you tell me spray vs. UV and where in Charlotte you are, I’ll give a short list of highly rated salons in that area and what to ask when you call.
